notes:
Account overview: Large regional healthcare provider focused on perioperative and surgical records. Heavy PHI footprint; strict residency and retention requirements. Primary ask is Private VPC deployment with full SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning and fine-grained RBAC in the Redwood Console/control plane.

Recent context and quotes:
- 2024-11-20 discovery call (Jordan/Priya): "We need proof we can isolate PHI at rest and in-process; no cross-tenant data leakage."
- 2024-11-27 security workshop (Diego + infra): asked for KMS integration (customer-managed keys), end-to-end audit logs, and ability to export full audit trails to their SIEM.
- 2024-12-02 legal asked for specific clause on data residency (state-level).

Technical requirements (CRM-style bullets):
- Workload: clinical-assistant + doc-search across EHR attachments (PDFs/scans) and structured records. Expect lots of embeddings and reranking.
- Latency: conversational < 300ms p95 for short responses; batch embeddings throughput target 2k reqs/min initially.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high; willing to commit to reserved capacity if SLA + security controls meet requirements.
- Models: prefer open/quantized models; want option to pin to vetted model family. Auto-fallback to lower-cost variants allowed but must respect PHI policy.
- Routing/Fallback: primary VPC -> fallback to dedicated (not public hosted) only after compile-verified encryption and logging retained.

Security & ops specifics captured in meeting: 
- SSO/SAML must integrate with Okta; SCIM provisioning required for automated user/group sync.
- RBAC: need 6 named admin roles + granular route-level permissions (create/run/purge cache/assign model pins).
- Audit: immutable, tamper-evident logs with 7-year retention exportable to Palo Alto Cortex and Splunk.
- KMS: Bring-your-own-key (BYOK) with HSM-backed keys; key rotation policy and ability to rotate without downtime.
- Data residency: primary region us-east-2, with option to store backups in us-central-1; legal requires written guarantees.

POC and evaluation notes:
- Agreed POC scope: 6-week VPC trial (staging) demonstrating SSO+SCIM user flows, RBAC enforcement, audit export, sample KMS integration.
- Deliverables: POC runbook, security checklist, performance runbook (latency/throughput baselines), and SOW draft.
- POC metrics: p95 latency, token-cost per response, successful SCIM provisioning events, number of audit events exported per hour.

Admin/ops handoffs: 
- SE Priya to deliver POC infra templates.
- Diego to coordinate with customer security and legal; update SOC/ISO evidence pack.
- Jordan leading commercial (pricing + ARR).

Open questions (short):

- Is there a mechanism to mask tokens in audit logs when required by compliance?
- Exact SLA numbers legal will accept for data residency breach.
